name: AnimatedList
description: A scrollable list of widgets that animates items when they are inserted or removed. Useful for dynamic lists where items can appear or disappear with smooth animations.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional key to uniquely identify the AnimatedList.

properties.name: initialItemCount
properties.description: The number of items the list starts with.

properties.name: itemBuilder
properties.description: Called to build each child in the list. Provides the index and an animation for insertion/removal.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Controls the scroll offset of the list.

properties.name: scrollDirection
properties.description: The axis along which the list scrolls.

properties.name: reverse
properties.description: Whether the list scrolls in the opposite direction.

properties.name: physics
properties.description: How the list should respond to user scrolling.

properties.name: shrinkWrap
properties.description: Whether the list should occupy only the space it needs.
